title: Act: Add optional interaction to characterSchema
summary: Add characterInteractionSchema and optional interaction field
description: Edit game/src/content/schema.ts: define an interaction object schema with optional dialogue string and optional actions array of actionSchema, and add it as an optional field of characterSchema.
acceptance_criteria: characterSchema has an optional interaction field
CharacterSpec infers interaction with optional dialogue and actions

steps.action: Add an exported zod object schema characterInteractionSchema with optional dialogue (z.string()) and optional actions (z.array(actionSchema)), placed before characterSchema.
Add the field interaction: characterInteractionSchema.optional() after the animations field.
